title: Transformers: Prime
description: Roll out with Optimus Prime, Bumblebee, Arcee, Ratchet, Bulkhead, and the rest of the heroic Autobots as they battle the evil Decepticons. Now that big bad Megatron has returned with a mysterious and dangerous element, Team Prime must prepare for an epic battle.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Prime 1x1
episodes_data.description: The Autobots go on alert as the Decepticons return to Earth in the series opener, Meanwhile a group of humans find themselves with new caretakers after stumbling into the middle of the Autobot conflict with the Decepticons.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Prime 1x2
episodes_data.description: The Autobots go in search of Cliffjumper, whose life signal is weak and find Megatron wielding the dangerous dark Energon.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Prime 1x3
episodes_data.description: Bulkhead is unknowingly shadowed by Miko as he goes to rescue Agent Fowler, who was kidnapped by the Decepticons.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Prime 1x4
episodes_data.description: The Autobots try to stave off an attack from Megatron's Terrorcons to protect their human wards.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Prime 1x5
episodes_data.description: The Decepticons and the Terrorcons go into battle against the Autobots.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Prime 1x6
episodes_data.description: Starscream pursues other interests while Skyquake battles with Optimus Prime and Bumblebee.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Prime 1x7
episodes_data.description: Scraplets invade HQ while Optimus and Arcee patrol the Arctic, leaving Bumblee and Ratchet to repel the enemy.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Prime 1x8
episodes_data.description: Bulkhead awaits a visit from his buddy Wheeljack, but his arrival does not go as planned.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Prime 1x9
episodes_data.description: The Autobots are attacked while helping Agent Fowler transport an implosion device.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Prime 1x10
episodes_data.description: Miko and Bulkhead go up against Starscream and Breakdown as they go to Greece to retrieve an Energon Harvester.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Prime 1x11
episodes_data.description: Jack tries to be impressive, with Bumblebee's help, but Knockout's arrivals sends things out of control.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Prime 1x12
episodes_data.description: Arcee must protect Jack when a routine mission is complicated by Airachnid's arrival.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Prime 1x13
episodes_data.description: A Decepticon plague infects Optimus Prime, so Arcee and Bumblebee sneak onto the Nemesis to find the cure.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Prime 1x14
episodes_data.description: Megatron controls Bumblebee from inside his mind and influences his behavior at HQ.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Prime 1x15
episodes_data.description: The kids are stranded with Skyquake in an alternate dimension during a GroundBridge malfunction.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Prime 1x16
episodes_data.description: MECH agents capture a Decepticon, and the Autobots mount a rescue.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Prime 1x17
episodes_data.description: Airachnid makes a deal with Silas to get revenge against Arcee and Jack.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Prime 1x18
episodes_data.description: The Autobots try to claim a magnetic weapon before the Decepticons get to it.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Prime 1x19
episodes_data.description: Two patrolling Autobots end up trapped in a cave with their enemies, Starscream and Megatron.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Prime 1x20
episodes_data.description: Starscream makes an unexpected request after he is captured by Optimus.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Prime 1x21
episodes_data.description: Bulkhead acquires a top-secret formula, and the Decepticons come after him for it.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Prime 1x22
episodes_data.description: Ratchet becomes a threat to everyone after he injects himself with an experimental substance.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Prime 1x23
episodes_data.description: The Decepticons quickly try to build a space bridge before a prophesied darkness arrives.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Prime 1x24
episodes_data.description: Earth has an outbreak of natural disasters, caused by Dark Energon.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Prime 1x25
episodes_data.description: The Autobots acquire a surprising ally in their battle to save Earth.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Prime 1x26
episodes_data.description: The Autobots go to the Earth's core to fight for the planet; and Jack uncovers info about Optimus' background.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Prime 2x1
episodes_data.description: Megatron manipulates the impaired Optimus into joining the Decepticons.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Prime 2x2
episodes_data.description: Jack learns how to restore Optimus' memory.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Prime 2x3
episodes_data.description: Optimus begins to piece together his real identity using several clues (including Starscream referring to his as a "prime" -- whoops!), and eventually rebels against Megatron’s orders. Meanwhile, Optimus' Autobot pals hatch a risky plan to get their leader back.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Prime 2x4
episodes_data.description: Bumblebee questions his worthiness to his team after he is compromised.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Prime 2x5
episodes_data.description: Bumblebee discovers that MECH and Starscream are responsible for his troubles; Ratchet confronts demons from his Cybertronian past.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Prime 2x6
episodes_data.description: Wheeljack returns to Earth, hot on the the trail of Skyquake's brother Dreadwing.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Prime 2x7
episodes_data.description: Megatron sends Dreadwing, Airachnid and Breakdown to investigate the trail of a potential Energon source, but what Airachnid doesn't know is that Dreadwing and Breakdown have actually been ordered to kill her for her treachery. She eventually catches wind of this, however, killing Breakdown and running off into the woods. Upon arriving at an abandoned Energon mine, Airachnid encounters Starscream cowering from a large Insecticon. After using her abilities to control the creature, she contacts Megatron and tells him to come to the mine, planning to use the Insecticon to kill him so she can claim Decepticon leadership...

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Prime 2x9
episodes_data.description: Following from the events of the previous episode, Agent Fowler is sat down to explain recent events to his superior, the cynical and disbelieving General Bryce. Threatened with a military tribunal and Team Prime's termination, Fowler tries to convince the General that the Autobots are still on the military's side, but the General believes that Optimus Prime went rogue and has perished, failing to fully understand that Nemesis Prime was not the real Optimus.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Prime 2x10
episodes_data.description: Bulkhead is trapped on the Decepticon Warship and amid dual tries on Megatron's life.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Prime 2x11
episodes_data.description:
Megatron infuses The Nemesis w/ his own supply of Dark Energon which results in the ship taking on a life of its own with its own agenda.

Meanwhile Optimus reluctantly decides to use the Spark Extractor in an attempt to bring the war to an end.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Prime 2x12
episodes_data.description: Megatron goes on a conquest to reveal the rest of the relics while Arcee and Bumblebee race him to New York City before Megatron gets there.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Prime 2x13
episodes_data.description: Optimus Prime travels to Antarctica to hunt down the second relic, but while there he is confronted by Dreadwing and Starscream, and finds himself caught between shifting alliances.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Prime 2x14
episodes_data.description: During a relic hunt, Ratchet and Wheeljack get a one-of-a-kind opportunity when Soundwave's flying minion, Laserbeak, is disabled.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Prime 2x15
episodes_data.description: Bulkhead, on mission for the fourth relic, came back in critical condition via ground bridge. What happened?!? One epic showdown as Bulkhead and Hardshell go head-to-head in the ongoing quest to gather the last of the Iaconian relics on Earth.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Prime 2x16
episodes_data.description: Miko and Wheeljack embark on a quest for revenge.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Prime 2x17
episodes_data.description: Arcee and a friend uncover a feat of Decepticon engineering intending to destroy the Autobots.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Prime 2x18
episodes_data.description: Starscream goes on a quest for Red Energon; a new Autobot joins Team prime.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Prime 2x19
episodes_data.description: After being granted a new start in his life, the ever stone-faced Silas begins to see the world in a new light and makes an out-of-character decision to go to Megatron in the hopes that he will be allowed to join the ranks of Decepticon.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Prime 2x20
episodes_data.description: Now that the location of the relics have been exposed by Orion Pax, the race is on to find the next one. New recruit Smokescreen and Jack are on the job with the Autobots looking to cut down Megatron before the beats them to it.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Prime 2x21
episodes_data.description: The Autobots find out about the Omega Keys and their secret. Meanwhile, Megatron attempts to control the power of the Primes.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Prime 2x22
episodes_data.description: As the race for the Omega Keys grows more desperate, Knock Out harnesses the power of sound, and Starscream the power of hyper-speed.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Prime 2x23
episodes_data.description: When the Decepticons take him captive, Smokescreen learns of the location of the final Omega Key - and attempts to retrieve all of the other stolen keys from Megatron.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Prime 2x24
episodes_data.description: In an effort to secure a peaceful truce that would be beneficial to all parties involved, Starscream offers Megatron a ceasefire but Dreadwing has other ideas and does whatever he can to keep the diplomatic agreement from taking place.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Prime 2x25
episodes_data.description: The Autobots and Megatron's Decepticons are drawn into Cybertron to face each other in a heroic battle over their mutual quests for the coveted Omega Lock, which, once unlocked with the four keys, would reawaken Primus'

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Prime 2x26
episodes_data.description: Due to Megatron's crafty plan, Optimus must make a hard decision which could affect the whole Autobot team.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Prime 3x1
episodes_data.description: While Optimus struggles to survive after Megatron’s destruction of the Autobot base, the separated members of Team Prime try to reconnect.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Prime 3x2
episodes_data.description: The Autobots search for signs of each other, but start to lose hope while the Decepticons welcome a key player to their ranks. A win for Wheeljack may ultimately lead to an Autobot defeat.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Prime 3x3
episodes_data.description: The Ultimate Autobot Hunter is unleashed on our heroes.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Prime 3x4
episodes_data.description: Led by a new member, Team Prime launches a desperate assault on the Decepticon citadel.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Prime 3x5
episodes_data.description: The Decepticons launch a new scheme to clone an army of beasts.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Prime 3x6
episodes_data.description: As tension builds within the Wreckers, they find themselves confronted with the return of the Predacon.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Prime 3x7
episodes_data.description: Unlikely duos team up, including Acree and Wheeljack, and Agent Fowler and Jack's mom.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Prime 3x8
episodes_data.description: Knock Out and Starscream experiment with synthetic lead and threaten to take over the Deceptacon ship and unleash an old enemy.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Prime 3x9
episodes_data.description: Megatron doubts Predacon and its allegiance after Predacon reveals a secret of its own.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Prime 3x10
episodes_data.description: Soundwave is captured by the Autobots; Megatron revives an old plan.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Prime 3x11
episodes_data.description: While Optimus faces off with Predaking, Megatron mounts a campaign to form a new alliance.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Prime 3x12
episodes_data.description: Ratchet reluctantly agrees to help the Decepticons perfect the synthetic energon formula. But once it is completed, he decides he can't allow the Decepticons to have it or finish building their new Omega Lock, so he sabotages the project and tries to escape from the ship. The Autobots launch their drone and Optimus Prime follows it, but along the way he is confronted by Starscream and his armada.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Prime 3x13
episodes_data.description: The Autobots face the Decepticons for a final showdown.
